crossRefs.note: Then the woman said, “Please let your servant speak a word to my lord the king.” He said, “Say on.”
Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”

translations.web: He said moreover, I have something to tell you.” She said, “Say on.”
translations.bsb: Then he said, “I have something to tell you.” “Say it,” she answered.
translations.kjv: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.
translations.asv: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.
